summary_en: This study tests etentamig given with daratumumab, compared with daratumumab, lenalidomide, and dexamethasone (DRd), in adults with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma who are not eligible for transplant. Etentamig is given as an intravenous infusion or a subcutaneous injection, with daratumumab given as a subcutaneous injection, until the recommended phase 3 dose, and the study lasts about 16 years. The study measures adverse events, change in disease activity, and pharmacokinetics, according to the brief summary; this is a Phase 2/3 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa etentamig administrado con daratumumab, comparado con daratumumab, lenalidomida y dexametasona (DRd), en adultos con mieloma múltiple recién diagnosticado que no son elegibles para trasplante. El etentamig se administra como infusión intravenosa o inyección subcutánea, y el daratumumab como inyección subcutánea, hasta la dosis recomendada para fase 3; el estudio dura aproximadamente 16 años. El estudio mide los eventos adversos, el cambio en la actividad de la enfermedad y la farmacocinética, según el resumen breve; es un estudio de Fase 2/3.
who_for: Newly diagnosed multiple myeloma, confirmed by IMWG criteria
Investigator judges not suitable for high-dose chemotherapy and stem cell transplant
Frailty index score of 1 or higher
Measurable disease within 28 days before enrollment
not_for: Prior systemic therapy or stem cell transplant for myeloma, except a short course of corticosteroids
Investigational treatment within 30 days or 5 half-lives before first dose, or currently in another study
Known active central nervous system involvement of myeloma
Clinically significant kidney, nerve, psychiatric, hormone, metabolic, immune, lung, or liver disease in the last 6 months that would affect participation
